prompt: Whenever we walk past, Fiona says me the corner bakery closes at six.
answer: Whenever we walk past, Fiona tells me the corner bakery closes at six.
accepted_answers: Whenever we walk past, Fiona tells me the corner bakery closes at six.
Whenever we walk past, Fiona tells me that the corner bakery closes at six.
Whenever we walk past, Fiona says to me the corner bakery closes at six.
Whenever we walk past, Fiona says to me that the corner bakery closes at six.
explanation_ru: После глагола «say» нельзя ставить адресат без предлога («says me» — частая ошибка). Вместо этого используют «tells me» или «says to me», а время «closes» не сдвигается при настоящем вводном глаголе.

prompt: Our neighbour texted that the lift ___ broken, so we used the stairs.
explanation_ru: Ситуация относится к прошлому («texted», «used the stairs»), поэтому Present Simple в косвенной речи сдвигается в Past Simple — «was». Вариант «is» — типичная ошибка отсутствия сдвига времён.

prompt: Gareth reminds his team, "The weekly meeting starts right after lunch." → Gareth reminds his team …
answer: Gareth reminds his team that the weekly meeting starts right after lunch.
accepted_answers: Gareth reminds his team that the weekly meeting starts right after lunch.
Gareth reminds his team the weekly meeting starts right after lunch.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол «reminds» стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён в косвенной речи не требуется и «starts» остаётся в Present Simple.

prompt: The assistant told me that the station shop didn't sold any batteries.
answer: The assistant told me that the station shop didn't sell any batteries.
accepted_answers: The assistant told me that the station shop didn't sell any batteries.
The assistant told me that the station shop did not sell any batteries.
The assistant told me the station shop didn't sell any batteries.
The assistant told me the station shop did not sell any batteries.
explanation_ru: При сдвиге отрицания из Present Simple в Past Simple после «didn't» всегда идёт начальная форма глагола («sell»), а не вторая («sold»).

prompt: Priya needed a calm place. The librarian told her, "We have a quiet room."
options: The librarian said Priya that they had a quiet room.
The librarian told to Priya that they had a quiet room.
The librarian told Priya that they had a quiet room.
The librarian told Priya that we had a quiet room.
explanation_ru: После «tell» адресат идёт без предлога («told Priya»), местоимение «we» меняется на «they», а «have» сдвигается в «had». Варианты с «said Priya», «told to» и сохранённым «we» — частые ошибки.

prompt: Liam asks the driver if does the bus stop outside the school.
answer: Liam asks the driver if the bus stops outside the school.
accepted_answers: Liam asks the driver if the bus stops outside the school.
Liam asks the driver whether the bus stops outside the school.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного «does», а окончание «-s» переходит на смысловой глагол («the bus stops»).

prompt: Last Tuesday the police warned drivers that the main road was closed ___.
explanation_ru: При пересказе сообщения из прошлого («Last Tuesday») указатель времени «today» меняется на «that day». Оставлять «today», «tomorrow» или «now» без замены — частая ошибка.

prompt: Checking the scales at the post office, Marek explains that the parcel weighs two kilos and costs extra.
answer: Checking the scales at the post office, Marek explains that the parcel weighs two kilos and costs extra.
accepted_answers: Checking the scales at the post office, Marek explains that the parcel weighs two kilos and costs extra.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: вводный глагол «explains» стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому «weighs» и «costs» сохраняют форму Present Simple без сдвига в прошлое.

prompt: Before I lifted my spoon, the waiter politely warned me ___ the pumpkin soup because it contained nuts.
explanation_ru: Глагол «warn» в значении предостережения требует конструкции «warn + object + not to-infinitive». Типичная ошибка — ставить «not» после «to» («to not eat») или переносить повелительное «don't».

prompt: Elena reminded us that the hospital car park was not free on weekdays. → Elena reminded us, …
answer: Elena reminded us, "The hospital car park is not free on weekdays."
accepted_answers: Elena reminded us, "The hospital car park is not free on weekdays."
Elena reminded us, "The hospital car park isn't free on weekdays."
Elena reminded us: "The hospital car park is not free on weekdays."
Elena reminded us: "The hospital car park isn't free on weekdays."
explanation_ru: При переводе обратно в прямую речь сдвиг снимается: постоянное правило («on weekdays») в реплике звучит в Present Simple («is not» / «isn't»).

prompt: Planning our weekend trip, Tariq says, "The local museum opens on Sundays, so let's go then."
options: Tariq mentioned that the local museum opens on Sundays and suggested going then.
Tariq suggested to visit the local museum because it opened on Sundays.
Tariq mentioned us that the local museum opens on Sundays and suggested to go then.
Tariq suggested that we going to the local museum because it opens on Sundays.
explanation_ru: После «suggest» используется форма с «-ing» («suggested going»), а не инфинитив «to go», и «mention» не принимает прямой адресат «us». Расписание музея остаётся верным, поэтому «opens» сохраняется.

prompt: Farah rang her sister from the train and explained that the cottage garden here got plenty of sun.
answer: Farah rang her sister from the train and explained that the cottage garden there got plenty of sun.
accepted_answers: Farah rang her sister from the train and explained that the cottage garden there got plenty of sun.
Farah rang her sister from the train and explained the cottage garden there got plenty of sun.
explanation_ru: Фара звонила уже из поезда, а не из самого дома, поэтому слово «here» нужно заменить на «there». Оставлять «here» при смене места разговора — частая ошибка.

prompt: While the card machine was down, the clinic receptionist informed us that they ___ take card payments until noon.
explanation_ru: Событие завершилось в прошлом («was down», «until noon»), поэтому модальный глагол «can't» сдвигается в «couldn't». Формы «didn't could» и «weren't able» (без «to») грамматически неверны.

prompt: We sprinted down the stairs with our suitcases, only for a guard to tell us that the Edinburgh train has already left from platform four.
answer: We sprinted down the stairs with our suitcases, only for a guard to tell us that the Edinburgh train had already left from platform four.
accepted_answers: We sprinted down the stairs with our suitcases, only for a guard to tell us that the Edinburgh train had already left from platform four.
We sprinted down the stairs with our suitcases, only for a guard to tell us the Edinburgh train had already left from platform four.
explanation_ru: Рассказ ведётся в прошедшем времени («sprinted»), поэтому исходный Present Perfect («has already left») сдвигается в Past Perfect («had already left»).

prompt: Shortly before the charity ride, the route manager told the cyclists, "If the wind drops, the narrow bridge will be safe to cross."
options: The route manager told the cyclists that if the wind would drop, the narrow bridge would be safe to cross.
The route manager told the cyclists that if the wind dropped, the narrow bridge would be safe to cross.
The route manager said the cyclists that if the wind dropped, the narrow bridge will be safe to cross.
The route manager told the cyclists if the wind had dropped, the narrow bridge would be safe to cross.
explanation_ru: В условном предложении первого типа при пересказе в прошлом «drops» сдвигается в «dropped», а «will» — в «would». Ставить «would» в части с «if» или сохранять «will» неверно.

prompt: Viktor complained to the hotel manager, "I have paid extra for a bedroom facing the river, but my window overlooks a noisy alley." → Viktor complained to the hotel manager that …
answer: Viktor complained to the hotel manager that he had paid extra for a bedroom facing the river, but his window overlooked a noisy alley.
accepted_answers: Viktor complained to the hotel manager that he had paid extra for a bedroom facing the river, but his window overlooked a noisy alley.
Viktor complained to the hotel manager that he'd paid extra for a bedroom facing the river, but his window overlooked a noisy alley.
explanation_ru: При пересказе в прошлом меняются местоимения («I» → «he», «my» → «his») и времена: Present Perfect («have paid») переходит в Past Perfect («had paid»), а Present Simple («overlooks») — в Past Simple («overlooked»).

prompt: Sitting in the taxi to the airport, I suddenly asked my husband was the back gate locked.
answer: Sitting in the taxi to the airport, I suddenly asked my husband if the back gate was locked.
accepted_answers: Sitting in the taxi to the airport, I suddenly asked my husband if the back gate was locked.
Sitting in the taxi to the airport, I suddenly asked my husband whether the back gate was locked.
explanation_ru: Общий косвенный вопрос вводится союзом «if» или «whether» и требует прямого порядка слов («the back gate was locked»), без инверсии и пропущенного союза.

prompt: Before replacing the old pipes last month, the plumber asked me ___ when we turned the handle off.
options: if did the kitchen tap leak
explanation_ru: Старые трубы уже заменили в прошлом месяце, поэтому нужен союз «whether»/«if», прямой порядок слов без «did» и сдвиг глагола в Past Simple («leaked»).

prompt: Stepping onto the balcony, Sofia asked her flatmate, "Are the bedroom curtains dry enough to hang up yet?"
options: Sofia asked her flatmate were the bedroom curtains dry enough to hang up yet.
Sofia asked her flatmate if were the bedroom curtains dry enough to hang up yet.
Sofia asked her flatmate whether the bedroom curtains were dry enough to hang up yet.
Sofia asked to her flatmate if the bedroom curtains were dry enough to hang up yet.
explanation_ru: После «ask» адресат идёт без предлога («asked her flatmate»), общий вопрос вводится через «whether»/«if», а глагол «were» стоит после подлежащего («the bedroom curtains were»).

prompt: Last spring Ronan phoned the tour desk and asked, "Does the coach ticket include lunch?" → Last spring Ronan phoned the tour desk and asked …
answer: Last spring Ronan phoned the tour desk and asked if the coach ticket included lunch.
accepted_answers: Last spring Ronan phoned the tour desk and asked if the coach ticket included lunch.
Last spring Ronan phoned the tour desk and asked whether the coach ticket included lunch.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос «Does the coach ticket include lunch?» в косвенной речи вводится союзом «if» или «whether», вспомогательный «does» опускается, а «include» сдвигается в «included».

prompt: Hearing loud barking from the kitchen, my brother wondered if was the dog hungry or simply eager for his evening walk.
answer: Hearing loud barking from the kitchen, my brother wondered if the dog was hungry or simply eager for his evening walk.
accepted_answers: Hearing loud barking from the kitchen, my brother wondered if the dog was hungry or simply eager for his evening walk.
Hearing loud barking from the kitchen, my brother wondered whether the dog was hungry or simply eager for his evening walk.
explanation_ru: После «wondered if» в косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов: подлежащее «the dog» должно стоять перед глаголом «was», а не после него.

prompt: As temperatures dropped overnight, the new tenant texted our landlord to ask if he could check ___ properly before the weekend.
options: if does the bedroom heater work
whether did the bedroom heater work
explanation_ru: Внутри косвенного вопроса после «check» нужен союз «whether»/«if», прямой порядок слов без «did»/«does» и согласование времени в прошлом («worked»).

prompt: Ahead of her job interview, Kavita emailed the coordinator to ask whether the office building had a lift and whether she should arrive early.
answer: Ahead of her job interview, Kavita emailed the coordinator to ask whether the office building had a lift and whether she should arrive early.
accepted_answers: Ahead of her job interview, Kavita emailed the coordinator to ask whether the office building had a lift and whether she should arrive early.
explanation_ru: Предложение полностью верно: в обоих косвенных вопросах после «whether» использован прямой порядок слов, «has» сдвинуто в «had», а модальный «should» в косвенной речи не меняется.

prompt: Jakub asked the park ranger whether the forest path was suitable for small children and where the main trail started. → Jakub asked the park ranger, …
answer: Jakub asked the park ranger, "Is the forest path suitable for small children, and where does the main trail start?"
accepted_answers: Jakub asked the park ranger, "Is the forest path suitable for small children, and where does the main trail start?"
Jakub asked the park ranger, "Is the forest path suitable for small children and where does the main trail start?"
Jakub asked the park ranger: "Is the forest path suitable for small children, and where does the main trail start?"
Jakub asked the park ranger: "Is the forest path suitable for small children and where does the main trail start?"
explanation_ru: При возврате к прямой речи убирается союз «whether», возвращаются вопросительный порядок слов и вспомогательный «does», а прошедшие формы «was» и «started» переходят обратно в настоящее время («Is», «does ... start»).
